“With a staggering 43 percent of adults and 20 percent of children in the U.S. suffering from obesity, it’s clear we need to get serious about this growing health care crisis"

https://t.co/UoWfbsoZkX

Great to meet with @AdamSchefter to discuss Type 1 Diabetes. Early detection and innovation is key to fighting this disease.

As founder of the Preventive Health and Wellness Caucus in Congress, I know that improving access to early detection and advanced screenings can make all the difference.

Saddened by the death of one of our country’s finest in yet another tragic but completely avoidable training exercise.

It is beyond unacceptable that 123 soldiers and Marines lost their lives in noncombat vehicle deaths between 2011 and 2021.

https://t.co/TNnQnQna3s

With high tide approaching, our area continues to experience severe flooding.

If you need to drive, please continue to exercise extreme caution and visit the link below for up-to-date road closures. https://t.co/CPLU3bhO8p

To Make America Healthy Again, we need to start investing in food as medicine.🥦💉

I joined @DrMarkHyman in @TheHillOpinion to advocate a nutrition-focused approach to health care. Better foods lead to lower costs and longer, healthier and happier lives. https://t.co/mvgQqrptLU

Missing that extra hour of sleep this morning?

It turns out the twice-annual clock change can hurt our health and productivity. That’s why I’m fighting to make daylight saving time permanent and “lock the clock!”

Read my op-ed in the @HeraldTribune: https://t.co/Q7VjMQq2ya

Obesity not only has devastating effects on our health, but even impacts our military readiness.

I’m proud to work with @RepGwenMoore to relaunch the Congressional Preventive Health and Wellness Caucus and introduce legislation to combat military obesity.https://t.co/bmkdLJMXyc

Lifestyle changes are key to prevention. We need to:

🍬 Combat obesity, which affects ~42% of U.S. adults
🥦 Make it easier to follow a healthy diet and promote “food as medicine”
🏋️‍♂️ Encourage exercise, such as through @MikeKellyPA’s PHIT Act

Obesity not only leads to increased cancer risk, but also places a tremendous strain on our health care system.

I’m proud to chair the Health Subcommittee on @WaysandMeansGOP and co-chair the Congressional Preventive Health and Wellness Caucus to strengthen our nation’s health.

Improving veteran health through nutrition is a cause we can all rally behind. It honors their service and transforms our health care system from one that treats illness to one that prevents it.

Read my latest op-ed in @WashTimes: https://t.co/Nc0zW3ntek

Great to join @FoodTank and the Food is Medicine Institute at @TuftsUniversity to discuss the role of nutritious food in preventive care.

Focusing on food quality changed my life, which is why I'm working to promote access to nutrition for all Americans. #MAHA https://t.co/SNeCPq5vuD

We spend over $4 trillion a year on health care, yet Americans are only getting sicker. We must prioritize real nutrition to improve our health.

“Food is Medicine” only works if nutrition is part of the solution. #MAHA https://t.co/KvOUWmSWFy

Proud to see U.S. forces and nearly 20 allied nations come together to increase readiness and lethality.

As threats grow in the Indo-Pacific, we must stay vigilant.

This training is peace through strength in action. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/9jVmg2KOlW

Great to meet with Steven Williams, CEO of @PepsiCo North America, to discuss nutrition reform. 
 
We discussed how the “One Big, Beautiful Bill” includes key provisions that support hardworking Americans and promote healthier communities. https://t.co/yMvJ0sl8pH

Making America Healthy Again starts with working directly with the private sector to deliver smarter solutions.

Great to meet with @DrOzCMS to discuss how we’re partnering with industry to improve health through nutrition and deliver better care. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/4Or1Bq3urS

We must be the CEOs of our own health.

Our country spends nearly $5 trillion a year on health care, yet Americans are getting sicker.

As Chair of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I’m focused on prevention, nutrition and Making America Healthy Again. https://t.co/gq8wykW0So

As a grandfather of 10 under 10, I’m deeply concerned about the rise in obesity and chronic illness and the cost of continuing to treat illness instead of preventing it.

Investing in preventive care is key to saving lives and reducing the strain on our health care system. https://t.co/oonMMOlDYB

Nutrition education is vital to combat the chronic disease epidemic, but 75% of U.S. med schools lack required clinical nutrition classes.

As @WaysandMeansGOP Health Chair, I led a letter with @RepMcGovern to the @acgme urging better nutrition education. https://t.co/IgzD8txqH1 https://t.co/vxEV0P5QrT

Honored to be recognized by @NAACOSnews as a Champion of Value in Health Care for introducing the Healthcare Efficiency Through Flexibility Act.

This week, @WaysandMeansGOP unanimously advanced my bill to expand access to care and improve outcomes for patients and families. https://t.co/Nuk6hAXP1o

.@BMSNews will launch its new schizophrenia drug in the UK at the same price Americans pay.

This follows my push with @RepArrington to end foreign freeloading on American innovation so patients don’t pay the price. Thanks to @POTUS & @USTradeRep. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/SSZm0SJ0Mx

Proud to support @POTUS, @SecKennedy & @DrOzCMS as they rebuild rural health care infrastructure and improve outcomes nationwide.

As Chair of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I’ll continue supporting solutions that put American families first. https://t.co/NyXjvalGYx

Let’s Make America Healthy Again!

Nutrition is only part of the equation—we must also prioritize exercise and staying active. As Chair of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I’ll continue championing policies that promote wellness and healthy lifestyles. https://t.co/Rpa1kZqpVk

By forcing a shutdown, Democrats have endangered flood insurance for hundreds of thousands of Floridians when families need it most.
 
Hurricane season demands preparation, not political games.

.@SpeakerJohnson is exactly right.

Democrats' proposal would repeal commonsense Medicaid reforms to restore taxpayer-funded health care for illegal aliens.

We will not be held hostage by the Left’s reckless $1.5 trillion spending spree. https://t.co/Lx1D4deStk

Even the @nytimes is debunking Democrats’ false shutdown talking points.
 
Democrats have misused budget jargon to mislead the American people and cover for their $1.5 trillion in partisan spending demands. https://t.co/LeeX1fRYx3 https://t.co/bLnR39zZKk
